name: Ian Cheng
CoachIntroText1: Hi! I'm Ian. I've been snowboarding for over 13 years since I was ten. I have witnessed how snowboarding in Taiwan has transformed from a niche sport into a popular recreational activity. During college, thanks to the support and sponsorship from Perry and SPK Snowsensei Group, I had the opportunity to train in Japan and participate in competitions. Unfortunately, I suffered a spinal injury during a competition in my junior year, which forced me to temporarily set aside snowboarding and return to National Chung Cheng University to complete my degree.
CoachIntroText2: Years of snowboarding and professional training have helped me develop solid techniques and a deep understanding of the sport. Now, I am fully commited to pass on my passion and expience of the sport to you. I enjoy tailoring my teaching to suit student's learning style and helping them overcome fear. Whether you're into jumps, rails, or just getting started, I'd be happy to guide you to improve and push your limits together!
